verdict_text: NO. The merge computes the second task vector against the already-modified base: it sets `tmp = b + λ(ft1 − b)` and then adds `λ(ft2 − tmp)` instead of `λ(ft2 − b)`. This gives `b + λ(ft1−b) + λ(ft2−b) − λ²(ft1−b)`, which differs from the required formula by `0.16·(ft1 − b)` and will exceed the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance. This violates Required result step 2 (each task vector must be taken against the unmodified base), the exact ordering hazard the specification warns about.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
